title: LNSym ARMv8 AddLoop: Total-Correctness Termination Proof
description: Full-repository upstream ARMv8 verification snapshot from AWS Automated Reasoning's leanprover/LNSym (commit 49f8a1d9, Lean v4.35.0, Apache-2.0). Partial correctness (`AddLoop.partial_correctness`) is already fully proved in `Proofs/Experiments/AddLoop/AddLoop.lean`; closing the sole remaining `sorry` (`AddLoop.termination`) completes total correctness (`∀ s, pre s → ∃ n, exit (run s n)`) against 86 sorry-free prebuilt upstream `.olean` dependencies (hardlink-reused from existing LNSym snapshots).

tasks.title: Prove ARMv8 AddLoop termination (`AddLoop.termination`)
tasks.description: Closes the sole remaining `sorry` in `Proofs/Experiments/AddLoop/AddLoop.lean:615-620` (`AddLoop.termination`): prove `Termination ArmState` (`∀ s, pre s → ∃ n, exit (run s n)`) for the ARMv8 `x0 := x0 + x1` loop alongside already-proved `AddLoop.partial_correctness`, with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `leanprover/LNSym@49f8a1d9`.
